answer: Require each identity to escrow a 480-unit bond and serve a twenty-six epoch probation. Every round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for ten rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm thus locks 480 units per alias and replays twenty-six rounds, while an opal of matching traces exposes the ring, karst channels scatter assignments, and summit seals certify each review.
